title: Legora Reviews 41 Documents in Minutes with GPT-6 Astra
summary: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 financial documents in minutes, catching all four planted errors and boosting performance by 40%.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Legora deployed GPT-6 Astra to process 41 financial documents in minutes, identifying all four intentionally planted errors.
- The AI-powered workflow improved review performance by nearly 40% compared to previous methods.
- This case study demonstrates GPT-6 Astra's real-world capacity for complex document analysis in legal and financial sectors.


Legora, a legal-technology firm specializing in financial compliance, has demonstrated the real-world capabilities of OpenAI's[GPT-6 Astra](https://emergent.sh/news/openai-launches-gpt-6-astra-multimodal-ai) by processing 41 complex financial documents in a matter of minutes. The AI correctly identified all four intentionally planted errors across the dataset and delivered a performance improvement of nearly 40% compared to the firm's existing workflow, according to a detailed case study published on the OpenAI blog.


## The Financial Review Challenge


Financial statement review is a labor-intensive process that traditionally requires hours of manual work by trained analysts. Legora tested GPT-6 Astra on a deliberately challenging dataset: 41 documents containing standard financial disclosures mixed with subtle compliance errors. Four specific mistakes were planted across the corpus to evaluate the model's attention to detail and analytical rigor.


The test scenario mirrors typical legal due diligence workflows where firms must verify accuracy across thousands of pages under tight deadlines. Manual review of such volumes typically requires multiple analysts working in parallel, with frequent cross-checks to minimize oversight risk.


## GPT-6 Astra Performance and Accuracy


GPT-6 Astra processed the entire 41-document corpus in minutes, flagging all four planted errors without producing false positives. The model demonstrated sophisticated understanding of financial terminology, regulatory context, and cross-document consistency checks. According to Legora's internal metrics, the AI-powered workflow reduced total review time by 38% while maintaining 100% accuracy on error detection.


- Processed 41 financial documents in under 10 minutes
- Identified all four planted compliance errors with zero false negatives
- Reduced workflow time by 38% compared to human-only review
- Maintained contextual understanding across multi-page documents


The performance gains stem from[GPT-6 Astra's advanced reasoning capabilities](https://emergent.sh/learn/gpt-6-astra-benchmarks) and extended context window, which allows the model to hold entire document sets in working memory simultaneously.


## Release Date and Availability


Officially launched on January 15, 2026, GPT-6 Astra represents OpenAI's latest multimodal reasoning model. The system builds on the GPT-6 architecture with enhanced document-processing capabilities specifically designed for professional workflows in legal, financial, and compliance sectors.


The model is currently available through OpenAI's API and enterprise licensing channels. Organizations interested in[GPT-6 Astra pricing](https://emergent.sh/learn/gpt-6-astra-pricing) can access tiered plans based on usage volume and deployment requirements.


## Legal Tech and AI Document Analysis


Legora's deployment follows a growing trend of law firms and compliance departments adopting large language models for high-stakes document work. The firm reports that GPT-6 Astra's ability to maintain accuracy across lengthy documents while operating at machine speed addresses two critical pain points: human fatigue during repetitive review tasks and the escalating costs of manual due diligence.


The case study also highlights the model's capacity for nuanced interpretation. Rather than simple keyword matching, GPT-6 Astra demonstrated understanding of financial context, flagging errors that required cross-referencing multiple sections and recognizing discrepancies that might escape notice during rushed manual review.


## What This Means


Legora's results provide concrete evidence that frontier AI models like[GPT-6 Astra](https://emergent.sh/news/openai-launches-gpt-6-astra-multimodal-ai) can deliver measurable productivity gains in professional services. The 40% performance improvement and perfect error-detection rate suggest these tools are ready for production deployment in scenarios where accuracy and speed are both critical. As legal and financial firms face mounting pressure to reduce costs while maintaining quality, AI-powered document review may shift from experimental to standard practice across the industry.
